-ङ्गम् The sheath of a bud (opp. to मूल); तत्रैतच्छुङ्गमुत्पतितं सोम्य विजानीहि नेदममूलं भविष्यतीति [[Ch. Up. 6. 8. 5.]]

__1 The sheath of a young bud. 
__2 The awn of barley or corn. 
__3 The waved-leaf fig. 
-Comp. 
-कर्मन् a ceremony connected with पुंसवन at which the शुङ्गा of the वट tree is used.
